evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut.
